perMember.label: Champions per player

patch.label: Patch {{version}}
patch.hint: Names and icons come from this Data Dragon version.
patch.missingDescription: Without the patch version, a champion name and icon mean nothing three months from now, so the server returns none at all. Players are still listed, and champions will come back as soon as the connector answers.

withoutRole.title: No role assigned
withoutRole.description: These players are on the roster but hold no role. Roles are set from the Roster tab.

roster.emptyDescription: Add players from the Roster tab — coaches are left out of this panel.

member.unknownChampionHint: Released after the served version: the server keeps it rather than hiding a real mastery.

COMPTE_RIOT_ABSENT.title: Riot account not linked
COMPTE_RIOT_ABSENT.description: No Riot account answers to this Riot ID yet. The person links it from My profile, then claims their seats.

MAITRISES_INDISPONIBLES.title: Masteries not retrieved
MAITRISES_INDISPONIBLES.description: The Riot connector did not answer for this player. Nothing to do: try again later.

CATALOGUE_INDISPONIBLE.title: Catalogue unavailable
CATALOGUE_INDISPONIBLE.description: Without the catalogue there is no name, no icon and no version — so no champion is returned, for anyone.

AUCUNE_MAITRISE.title: No mastery
AUCUNE_MAITRISE.description: Riot answered, and this account has no mastery yet. That is information, not a failure.
